source_quote: The following AI practices shall be prohibited:
description_en: Practices the Act forbids outright, such as manipulative techniques, social scoring and untargeted scraping of facial images.
description_sv: Metoder som lagen förbjuder helt, till exempel manipulativa tekniker, social poängsättning och oriktad insamling av ansiktsbilder.

legal_basis: Article 6 and Annexes I and III
source_quote: In addition to the high-risk AI systems referred to in paragraph 1, AI systems referred to in Annex III shall be considered to be high-risk.
description_en: Systems that are safety components of regulated products (Annex I) or used in the areas listed in Annex III, such as employment, education and access to essential services. Most obligations attach here.
description_sv: System som är säkerhetskomponenter i reglerade produkter (bilaga I) eller används inom områdena i bilaga III, till exempel anställning, utbildning och tillgång till viktiga tjänster. Här ligger de flesta skyldigheterna.

label_en: Certain AI systems with transparency obligations
source_quote: Providers shall ensure that AI systems intended to interact directly with natural persons are designed and developed in such a way that the natural persons concerned are informed that they are interacting with an AI system
common_name_en: limited risk (not a term used in the Act)
description_en: Systems that interact with people, generate synthetic content, recognise emotions or produce deep fakes: people must be told.
description_sv: System som interagerar med människor, skapar syntetiskt innehåll, känner igen känslor eller gör deepfakes: människor ska informeras.

source_quote: Providers of general-purpose AI models shall:
description_en: Models that can perform a wide range of tasks and are integrated into many systems: documentation, information for downstream providers, a copyright policy and a training-content summary.
description_sv: Modeller som kan utföra många olika uppgifter och byggs in i andra system: dokumentation, information till leverantörer i senare led, en upphovsrättspolicy och en sammanfattning av träningsinnehållet.

label_en: General-purpose AI models with systemic risk
label_sv: AI-modeller för allmänna ändamål med systemrisk
source_quote: In addition to the obligations listed in Articles 53 and 54, providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk shall:
description_en: The most capable general-purpose models: evaluation and adversarial testing, systemic-risk mitigation, incident reporting and cybersecurity, on top of the general obligations.
description_sv: De mest kapabla modellerna för allmänna ändamål: utvärdering och adversariell testning, minskning av systemrisker, incidentrapportering och cybersäkerhet, utöver de allmänna skyldigheterna.

source_quote: Providers and deployers of AI systems shall take measures to support the development of AI literacy of their staff
common_name_en: minimal risk (not a term used in the Act)
description_en: Obligations that are not tied to a risk class, such as AI literacy. Systems outside the classes above have no class-specific obligations under the Act.
description_sv: Skyldigheter som inte hör till någon riskklass, som AI-kunnighet. System utanför klasserna ovan har inga klasspecifika skyldigheter enligt lagen.
